summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that the company and its wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired treasury shares under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 on October 9, 2026, settling October 13, 2026. CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average AR$2,037.49 for AR$244,499,775; Proener bought 30,000 ADRs (300,000 equivalent shares) on the NYSE at USD12.69 for USD380,764.92. Acquisitions stayed under 25% of the prior 90-day average daily volume. This is a routine open-market buyback disclosure, not a special situation; watch ongoing repurchase pace and Argentine regulatory buyback limits.
